primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: The 28-day motor seizure frequency in the double-blind period was calculated as the (number of motor seizures)/ (the number of valid days where motor seizure count information is present) \* 28 within the double-blind period. The baseline of the seizure frequency used the 28 days observations immediately prior to treatment start date for this calculation.

groups.description: Participants received vatiquinone 15 mg/kg if body weight \<13 kg, and 200 mg if body weight ≥13 kg, administered orally, TID for up to 24 weeks during the double-blind period.
groups.title: Double-blind Period: Vatiquinone

groups.description: Participants received vatiquinone-matched placebo, administered orally, TID for up to 24 weeks during the double-blind period.
groups.title: Double-blind Period: Placebo

primaryOutcomeMeasures.populationDescription: ITT population included all randomized participants who received at least 1 dose of treatment.
primaryOutcomeMeasures.title: Percent Change From Baseline to Week 24 in the Number of Observable Motor Seizures Per 28 Days During the Double-blind Period
